From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Retention snapshot + KMS inventory — action items for Q2

Team —

We need to get a short, actionable snapshot for Q2 that answers three questions for sales/procurement calls next week: 1) current audit-log retention windows by product tier (hosted / dedicated / private), 2) per-tenant KMS mapping (which tenants are BYOK / Redwood-managed / escrow), and 3) any short-term exception we can offer a pilot customer (30/90 day short window).

I've attached the initial retention_snapshot_q2.xlsx with my rough column headings. Can each of you own parts below and reply with a single line ETA?

- Marissa: product policy specifics and feasibility (can we ship a 30-day short-term retention toggle for pilots within Q2?).
- Soojin: a snapshot of KMS mappings + whether there are blockers to exportable evidence for tenants (and link to the inventory).
- Ben: compliance evidence path (what artifacts we can provide today for SOC2-style requests), and any manual steps needed for exceptions.
- Priya: operations handoff if we need to coordinate infra changes / runbooks.

Goal: consolidate into a one-page deck for Sales by 2028-03-29 EOD. If any blocker, flag now.

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_snapshot_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks Logan — quick notes from infra/security side: 

- I uploaded an exported inventory (kms_key_inventory_v1.pdf) to the shared Drive (link above). It maps tenant IDs -> key type (BYOK | Redwood | Escrow) and region.
- Immediate blocker: for a subset of private tenants we do not have a documented key-rotation policy in the system (manual processes only). That will affect evidence packaging but not retention toggles.
- Exportable audit evidence: we can generate per-tenant log bundles (S3) today but redaction/PII scrubbing is manual for some customers — estimated manual effort ~2-3 engineer hours per request for medium tenants.

ETA for machine-readable KMS mapping (CSV): 2028-03-27 17:00 PT.

Logan — prioritization notes from Product: 

- Short-term retention toggle (30/90 day) for pilots: feasible with a safe defaults rollout if we implement a config flag at the routing layer + a quick UI toggle. Rough engineering estimate: 4 sprints (we can do a fast-path MVP in 6 weeks if we scope to hosted-only).
- Dedicated / Private: needs infra/ops involvement (SLA changes + config management). We can document a manual process for pilots and mark as "non-GA" in the one-pager.
- Risk: we need clear language on what "retention" means for cached prefixes/KV caches vs persisted audit logs — recommend we keep the one-pager high-level and include a link to the full tech appendix.

Proposed ETA for product copy + decision: 2028-03-29 12:00 PT. I can draft the one-pager.

Adding compliance context for Sales/Procurement: 

- What we can provide today: per-tenant audit log export (raw logs), signed key metadata for BYOK tenants, and time-series usage slices for billing reconciliation.
- Gaps: no automated redaction pipeline for exported logs (manual review required for any customer with regulated PHI/PII).
- Exception playbook: we have an established manual "short-term retention" carveout (executive approval + ticket in JIRA-SEC-4621). For small pilots we can accept a signed exception with specific timeboxes (I recommend 30 days). Ops will create a runbook.

I'll create the short compliance bullet list and attach to the one-pager. ETA for my bullet list: 2028-03-28 15:00 PT.
